The landlord was emailed on 11 Oct and hasn't replied in 3 days, and this is the first missed follow-up, so I chased them by email rather than escalating. I also gave the tenant an update and asked whether the door still locks securely, so it can be treated as urgent if not. The case is on hold for 2 days. If the landlord still hasn't replied by then, it should go to a human.
